name_or_item: Shanghai Transrapid demonstration line final account

notes: Approved budget estimate RMB 10,029.9m; board-approved final account RMB 9,943m at end April 2004. Main-line length 29.873 km (Xinhua, 26 Apr 2006); many sources round to 30 km.

scope: vehicles, operation control, propulsion and power supply, long-stator packs and winding cables, switch steel bending girders

scope: concrete composite guideway girder system technology

name_or_item: Shanghai Chinese-side civil works and other costs (derived)
scope: residual of the final account after the two German contracts: guideway girders, piers and piling, two stations, maintenance base, girder factory, land, installation of German equipment, design and management
notes: 9943 minus 5280. The guideway alone is a subset. The line needed about 20000 piles of 40-60 m in soft ground (Grossert, Promet 15 (2003) 117-125).

scope: girders, piers, piles and bearings only; excludes stations, maintenance base, girder factory, land, vehicles and all electrical systems
notes: Assumes the guideway is 65-80 per cent of the residual, giving RMB 51-62m per track-km. This is the only guideway-only figure obtainable for Shanghai and it is an inference, not a published line item.

scope: double track; the guideway beam on a prepared formation 0.1-2 m high, including foundations; excludes piers, stator support rail, switches, land and project management
